name: @w6w-apps/eventbrite
description: Read events, orders, attendees and ticket classes from Eventbrite.

w6w.longDescription:
Eventbrite reads events, orders and attendees directly into a workflow — listing and fetching events, pulling the orders and attendees tied to them, and reading ticket classes to see what was actually offered for sale.

Organizations and organizers are available too: an account's organizations can be listed, and organizers can be listed or fetched individually, which matters for anyone managing events across more than one Eventbrite organizer profile.

A fit for keeping attendee and order data in sync with a CRM or spreadsheet, triggering follow-up actions once an event's attendee list is known, or reporting on ticket sales without logging into Eventbrite's own dashboard. This app reads Eventbrite data; it does not create or modify events, orders or tickets.
